fact: Africa50 and Bayobab (MTN Group) announced a partnership in May 2023 to co-develop Project East2West, a US$320-325 million terrestrial fibre network linking landlocked countries to east and west coast subsea cables, with Mozambique among the twelve countries named as covered.

Zambia and Mozambique officially launched the Chanida-Cassacatiza cross-border fibre-optic interconnector, linking Zambia's national backbone to Mozambique's submarine-cable network, at a commissioning ceremony reported on 2026-02-23 (Zambia's technology minister and Mozambique's communications minister speaking); the date is the document's published date.
source_slug: 2026-02-23 Zambia and Mozambique launch fibre-optic interconnector at Chanida–Cassacatiza border
